card.name: Small connecting words after drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking or punctuation tokens such as "with", "of", an opening parenthesis or a line break that follow a drug name or list item. Most often seen in "ombitasvir/paritaprevir/ritonavir, with or without dasabuvir".

modes.label: With or without dasabuvir
modes.description: The word "with" right after the ombitasvir/paritaprevir/ritonavir regimen name.
